title: DelegateCapsuleArgs
description: Fixed parent-agent tool envelope. output_example is prompt guidance, never parsed or compiled into a result schema.

capsule.description: Self-contained instructions, context, constraints, local discretion, and yield gate.

output_example.description: Self-explanatory example or format guidance passed verbatim to Flash. Does not need to be valid JSON.

timeout_s.description: Positive finite per-call seconds, overriding the plugin default. Runtime must handle timer range safely. Separate cleanup allowance: 5 seconds.
